headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Base Lines Hold
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the principal struggle still concentrated on a handful of contested fronts, though the tempo has shifted since the previous edition. LinnMercyHex has risen to sixteen strategic-base events in twenty-four hours, including three in the last two, with casualty rates accelerating on both sides; its holdings remain eleven Colonial to none Warden? Current ownership is eleven Colonial and no Warden. WeatheredExpanseHex remains the busiest arena by recent history, with twenty-two daily events and fighting rates accelerating sharply, while its divided line stands five Colonial to four Warden. StonecradleHex holds eleven daily events and three in six hours, with both casualty streams and enlistments accelerating; ownership is six Colonial to three Warden. DeadLandsHex records five daily events and three in six hours, but its immediate casualty and enlistment rates have cooled. MooringCountyHex has eight daily events, chiefly earlier in the period, with no change in the last six hours. StlicanShelfHex likewise remains divided six Warden to three Colonial after seven daily events, though its latest activity has quieted. These sectors offer the clearest warning of possible near-term base movement.
